# The import-map probe corpus (PARITY IM1) — ONE set of bytes, served to BOTH engines.
#
# Chrome 150.0.7871.46 was asked for it over `python3 -m http.server` and its answer is
# `import-map-probe.chrome-150.txt`; `import_map_live.rs` serves this same file from a `TcpListener`
# and asserts korvus prints the same lines. The two drivers share these bytes rather than two copies
# of them, because a probe that drifts between the engine's copy and the browser's copy proves
# nothing at all.
#
# FORMAT. One file per `=== <path> <content-type>` header; the body is every line up to the next
# header, verbatim (the blank separator line included -- both parsers keep it, so neither has to
# trim). Lines beginning `#` BEFORE the first header are this comment; after it they are body.
#
# THE ORIGIN IS `<origin>` NOWHERE IN HERE and everywhere in the transcript: Chrome was served on a
# fixed port and the Rust test binds port 0, so both drivers rewrite their own origin to `<origin>`
# before comparing. Nothing else is normalized.
#
# RE-RECORD (an idle box; Chrome's answer was identical on two runs, and two runs is the standard):
#
#   1. Lay this file out as a directory -- for each `=== <path> <ctype>` header, write the lines up
#      to the next header to `<dir>/<path>`.
#   2. `python3 -m http.server 8931 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory <dir>`
#   3. `google-chrome --headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --user-data-dir=$(mktemp -d)
#      --virtual-time-budget=4000 --dump-dom http://127.0.0.1:8931/index.html`
#   4. Take the text of `<pre id="out">`, replace `http://127.0.0.1:8931` with `<origin>`, and write
#      it to `import-map-probe.chrome-150.txt`. Repeat step 3 and diff the two before committing.

=== /index.html text/html
<!doctype html>
<meta charset=utf-8>
<title>import-map probe</title>
<script>
window.__R = [];
window.rec = (k, v) => { window.__R.push(k + " = " + v); };
window.probe = async (label, spec) => {
  try { const m = await import(spec); window.rec(label, "OK " + m.who); }
  catch (e) { window.rec(label, "THROW " + e.constructor.name + ": " + e.message); }
};
window.meta = (label, fn) => {
  try { window.rec(label, fn()); }
  catch (e) { window.rec(label, "THROW " + e.constructor.name + ": " + e.message); }
};
window.addEventListener("error", (e) => {
  window.rec("uncaught", (e.error ? e.error.constructor.name + ": " : "") + e.message);
}, true);
</script>
<script type="importmap">
{
  "imports": {
    "dep": "/js/dep.js",
    "@theme/": "/js/theme/",
    "@theme/nested/": "/js/alt/",
    "@theme/section": "/js/other.js",
    "nonslash/": "/js/theme",
    "numval": 42,
    "arrval": ["/js/dep.js"],
    "nullish": null,
    "": "/js/evil.js",
    "./relative-a.js": "/js/root-a.js",
    "/absolute-a.js": "/js/root-a.js",
    "https://example.invalid/x.js": "/js/root-a.js"
  },
  "scopes": {
    "/sub/": { "dep": "/js/s-sub.js" },
    "/sub/a/": { "dep": "/js/s-deep.js" },
    "/sub/exact.js": { "dep": "/js/s-exact.js" },
    "/": { "dep": "/js/s-root.js" },
    "/fall/": { "other": "/js/other.js" }
  }
}
</script>
<script type="importmap">
{
  "imports": { "dep": "/js/other.js", "extra": "/js/other.js" },
  "scopes": { "/sub/": { "dep": "/js/other.js" }, "/deep/": { "dep": "/js/s-second.js" } }
}
</script>
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": { "broken": "/js/dep.js", }
</script>
<script type="importmap">
[1, 2, 3]
</script>
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": [1, 2], "scopes": { "/": { "never": "/js/dep.js" } } }
</script>
<script type="importmap" src="/late-map.json">
{ "imports": { "from-src": "/js/dep.js" } }
</script>
<script type="importmap"></script>
<body>
<script>
window.classic = window.probe("classic script import()", "dep");
</script>
<script type="module">
// AWAITED FIRST so the transcript has one order: an unawaited classic `import()` settles
// against the module's own probes and the two interleave differently run to run.
await window.classic;
await window.probe("exact key", "dep");
await window.probe("prefix key", "@theme/index.js");
await window.probe("longer prefix key wins", "@theme/nested/deep.js");
await window.probe("exact key beats prefix key", "@theme/section");
await window.probe("value is not a directory", "nonslash/section.js");
await window.probe("value is a number", "numval");
await window.probe("value is an array", "arrval");
await window.probe("value is null", "nullish");
await window.probe("empty key maps nothing", "anything");
await window.probe("no mapping at all", "react/jsx-runtime");
await window.probe("backtracking out of the prefix", "@theme/../evil.js");
await window.probe("relative specifier remapped", "./relative-a.js");
await window.probe("absolute specifier remapped", "/absolute-a.js");
await window.probe("external specifier remapped", "https://example.invalid/x.js");
await window.probe("relative specifier not in the map", "./js/plain.js");
await window.probe("second map cannot overwrite", "dep");
await window.probe("second map adds a key", "extra");
await window.probe("a discarded map maps nothing", "broken");
await window.probe("an external map maps nothing", "from-src");
await window.probe("a bad-imports map maps nothing", "never");
await window.probe("scope /sub/a/", "/sub/a/importer.js");
await window.probe("scope /sub/", "/sub/importer.js");
await window.probe("scope is an exact file", "/sub/exact.js");
await window.probe("scope added by the second map", "/deep/importer.js");
await window.probe("scope with no such key falls to the next scope", "/fall/importer.js");
await window.probe("a module reached THROUGH the map", "@theme/chain.js");
window.meta("meta.resolve mapped", () => import.meta.resolve("dep"));
window.meta("meta.resolve prefix", () => import.meta.resolve("@theme/index.js"));
window.meta("meta.resolve directory key", () => import.meta.resolve("@theme/"));
window.meta("meta.resolve unmapped", () => import.meta.resolve("react/jsx-runtime"));
window.meta("meta.resolve null value", () => import.meta.resolve("nullish"));
window.meta("meta.resolve backtracking", () => import.meta.resolve("@theme/../evil.js"));
window.meta("meta.resolve relative", () => import.meta.resolve("./x.js"));
const injected = document.createElement("script");
injected.type = "importmap";
injected.textContent = JSON.stringify({ imports: { injected: "/js/dep.js" } });
document.head.appendChild(injected);
await window.probe("a map the page injected", "injected");
// THE RESOLVED MODULE SET. Everything above has resolved (or failed to), so this last map is the
// one that may not move what is already settled. `./js/plain.js` resolved and is in no map;
// `react/jsx-runtime` FAILED; `late-only` has never been mentioned.
const late = document.createElement("script");
late.type = "importmap";
late.textContent = JSON.stringify({ imports: {
  "/js/plain.js": "/js/other.js",
  "/js/": "/js/alt/",
  "react/jsx-runtime": "/js/other.js",
  "late-only": "/js/other.js"
} });
document.head.appendChild(late);
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50));
window.meta("late map, key already resolved", () => import.meta.resolve("/js/plain.js"));
window.meta("late map, prefix over a resolved key", () => import.meta.resolve("/js/evil.js"));
window.meta("late map, key that FAILED to resolve", () => import.meta.resolve("react/jsx-runtime"));
window.meta("late map, a key nobody asked for", () => import.meta.resolve("late-only"));
// AN EMPTY IMPORT MAP IS NOT A MAP: HTML returns from "prepare the script element" before the
// already-started step, so nothing is parsed, nothing is reported, and the element can be retyped
// and run afterwards. Whitespace is NOT empty and IS reported.
const blank = document.createElement("script");
blank.type = "importmap";
document.head.appendChild(blank);
const spaces = document.createElement("script");
spaces.type = "importmap";
spaces.textContent = "   ";
document.head.appendChild(spaces);
blank.type = "text/javascript";
blank.textContent = "window.rec('the empty map element ran as a classic script', 'yes')";
document.head.appendChild(blank);
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50));
window.rec("supports importmap", HTMLScriptElement.supports("importmap"));
window.rec("import maps in document.scripts", [...document.scripts].filter((s) => s.type === "importmap").length);
const pre = document.createElement("pre");
pre.id = "out";
pre.textContent = window.__R.join("\n");
document.body.appendChild(pre);
</script>
